title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: streaming stability, function-calls, roles + stop/logprobs and response formatting
author: Caroline Huang
description: Summary: Implements additional OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity across the API surface: stabilizes streaming chunk boundaries, completes function/tool-calling wire format support, aligns message role handling with OpenAI semantics, adds stop and logprobs passthrough, and improves response formatting (choices/message/content vs. choices/text). Motivation: Customers expect the Redwood OpenAI-compat layer to behave identically to OpenAI for chat completions, especially for streaming & function-calling workloads. We saw multiple customer regressions where streaming deltas and function call boundaries differed from OpenAI leading to parser errors and duplicated function-invocation events. This PR addresses those gaps and includes backward-compatible toggles where applicable. Checklist: - [x] Stabilize streaming chunk assembly and finalization semantics - support delta merges, correct final content markers, and enforce chunk order under reordering conditions. - [x] Add full function-calling response encoding parity (name/arguments as structured JSON), including streaming function call deltas and final call payload. - [x] Normalize roles: map assistant/system/user properly, preserve custom role strings in metadata, and document behavior. - [x] Passthrough stop sequences and logprobs when requested by client (legacy OpenAI params). - [x] Update SDK surface (python/ts) to expose new streaming function events and role normalization helpers. - [x] E2E tests covering streaming + function call interleaving, malformed function outputs, and stop token behavior. - [x] Add release notes and migration guidance for customers relying on legacy non-structured responses. Implementation notes: - Streaming stability: introduced a deterministic chunk reassembler that buffers out-of-order fragments for a maximum of 200ms before ordering by sequence id; emits partial chunks immediately for low-latency while ensuring final chunk contains consistent message boundaries. - Function calls: wire format now mirrors OpenAI v1: streaming deltas include {"delta": {"role": "assistant", "function_call": {"name": "<partial>", "arguments": "<partial>"}}}, final event emits complete "function_call" object and sets message.finish_reason appropriately. - Roles: messages labeled "system", "user", "assistant" are normalized; non-standard roles are forwarded in message.metadata.original_role. - stop/logprobs: when client passes stop or logprobs flags, the runtime will request the underlying model to emit stop/logprobs and the compatibility layer will forward fields into the response without re-encoding. Backwards-compat: default runtime behavior remains unchanged unless client uses OpenAI-compat header or uses /openai/v1/chat.completions endpoint. Migration: document lists examples of consuming structured function calls from streaming SDK helpers. Related: closes ENG-4231, ENG-4267, referenced in SUP-1183 for customer-reported parser failures.

review_conversation: Amit Patel: Nice work on the reassembler; a few nits on the ordering window and the hardcoded 200ms - can we make it configurable and document a recommended default?
Caroline Huang: Agreed. Made it configurable via runtime config (streaming.reassembly_window_ms) and added docs with recommended defaults for high-latency regions.
Sofia Ramirez: SDK changes LGTM. One comment: the TS helper currently emits both 'functionCall' and 'function_call' events for compatibility — can we standardize?
Caroline Huang: Standardized on 'function_call' across SDKs; added a compatibility alias in the first minor release for existing users.
Jonas Becker: Please add a test that simulates a model emitting a partial malformed JSON in function arguments (we want to ensure we surface parse errors instead of dropping payload).
Caroline Huang: Added e2e case 'malformed-function-args' and updated handler to emit a structured error event with finish_reason 'function_call_parse_error'.
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: improved streaming stability, full function-calling streaming parity (structured function_call deltas + final payload), normalized roles handling, passthrough for stop and logprobs. SDKs updated to surface streaming function call events. See docs/openai-compat.md for migration steps.
